implementation_status.description: Whether the artifact has been implemented

execution_status.description: Whether the artifact has been executed

evidence_class.description: Classification of the evidence the artifact provides

reproducibility_status.description: Whether the artifact's results are reproducible

rules.no_dual_purpose_fields: execution_status is separate from implementation_status. 'executed' is not an implementation status.
rules.no_inference_from_filename: If a record cannot be classified without guessing, use 'unknown' and record the ambiguity.
